comparisons.minimum_mechanism: The minimum credible mechanism is direct zero-signature deletion plus a separate whole-system transformation; the paper states exactly what each can and cannot establish rather than attributing the result to a larger framework.

decision.reason: The surviving theorem is sound but scientifically owned by the merged ORION-01 object; retaining a second manuscript would be portfolio fragmentation.

external_validity.description: Formal theorems and exact authored finite family witnesses; production transfer attempts are adverse or indeterminate.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Keep the title, abstract, contributions and conclusion at the fixed grammar/objective ceiling and retain the production-transfer failures.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The paper would be too narrow if framed as a general quantum-compilation or hardware result rather than an exact theorem about a declared compiler grammar.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Treat the all-size proofs and exact witness as authority; label every enumeration as bounded checking and report no population inference.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Finite enumerations can corroborate the proof but cannot be counted as independent empirical breadth or converted into performance claims.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Strip project terms, identify donor results explicitly, and retain only the compiler-specific whole-instance/objective bridge plus the matched and loose family consequences.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The binary rank identity, zero-sum machinery and proof-system relativity are donor mathematics, so vocabulary substitution would leave no novelty.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Bind the source and finite witnesses while preserving FINITE_PRODUCTION_REALIZATION_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED and CANNOT_CHECK_MOVE_COMPLETENESS as adverse terminals.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Hashes and replay establish execution integrity but not production move completeness or compiler transfer.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Audit every ORION-05 claim against ORION-01; retire ORION-05 as a submission and route non-core regime evidence to the merged ORION-09/10 object.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Standalone ORION-05 duplicates the support-two theorem now used by ORION-01 and fragments one reader-visible question.

novelty.component_novelty: No novelty is claimed for Pauli binary symplectic representations, zero-sum/rank facts, sparse-support bounds, block-wise quantum compilation or generic relative proof-system concepts.
novelty.composition_novelty: The bounded composition is the proved bridge from whole-instance compiler semantics and exact Restore sensitivity to a simultaneous support normal form, followed by matched-statistic tests of certificate sharpness.
novelty.emergent_result: The coupled analysis shows, within fixed objectives and support statistics, that one rank-only language is exact at support two in one family yet has budget five against intrinsic support one in another because a whole-system Tag reconstruction is unavailable to that language.

adverse_or_null_results: The finite production-realization certificate was rejected and production transfer remains unestablished.
The pinned PyZX attempt stopped after 74 of 4,681 words with CANNOT_CHECK_MOVE_COMPLETENESS; it does not establish production move completeness or a production certificate gap.
scientific_mass.dependence_notes: Finite checker rows, product copies and direct-enumeration counts are verification or definitional amplification, not additional independent science. The matched support-two theorem and dependent-triple separation share the common compiler-certificate question but supply different exact outcomes.
scientific_mass.failure_opportunities: The whole-instance/objective bridge could fail; the support-one obstruction could fail to exclude a smaller optimum; the dependent-triple rank basis or whole-system normalization could fail; the production-transfer attempts in fact failed or remained indeterminate.
scientific_mass.independent_unit_type: logically distinct theorem or exact family-separation object

sibling_overlap.merge_test: The all-size theorem, sharp support-one obstruction and mechanism are covered by ORION-01. Static-evaluator and regime-refutation evidence belongs to ORION-09/10. No standalone ORION-05 scientific question remains.

surviving_claim.plain_language: The frozen R6M grammar has an exact support-two optimum normal form, and a complete support-one search gives a sharp two-qubit obstruction.
surviving_claim.posterior_change: The support-two theorem is real, but it is already load-bearing inside the broader ORION-01 certificate-realization manuscript and does not justify a second submission.
